subject: Deploying shiny app - failed to parse due to dependencies

messages.author: 69eed3b9ebe2086b
messages.subject: Deploying shiny app - failed to parse due to dependencies
parts:
Hi all,

Reasonably new to R shiny and trying to deploy/share my app for the first time. I have created my basic ui.R and server.R files, and then have the following file code (have x'd out my shiny app credentials):

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(formattable)
library(ggplot2)
library(sqldf)
library(rmarkdown)
library(knitr)
library(rsconnect)

setwd("/Users/dylantooch/Documents/Shiny R")
getwd()

SampleData <- read.csv(file = "Sample data 20171219.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")
head(SampleData)
class(SampleData$Date)

SampleData$Clicks <- formattable(as.numeric(SampleData$Clicks), digits=4, format="f")
SampleData$ViewThrough <- formattable(as.numeric(SampleData$ViewThrough), digits=4, format="f")
SampleData$Imps <- formattable(as.numeric(SampleData$Imps), digits=4, format="f")

d <- as.POSIXlt(as.Date(SampleData$Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
d$year <- d$year + 2000
head(d)
SampleData$Date <- as.character(as.Date(d))

rsconnect::setAccountInfo(name='XXXXX', token='XXXXXXX', secret='XXXXXXX')

runApp()
deployApp()

The error I'm getting which I cannot get past:

DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 253928...DONE
Deploying bundle: 1162751 for application: 253928 ...
Waiting for task: 502911174
  building: Building image: 1164451
  building: Installing packages
  building: Installing files
  building: Pushing image: 1164451
  deploying: Starting instances
  rollforward: Activating new instances
  terminating: Stopping old instances
Application successfully deployed to https://xxxxxx.shinyapps.io/shiny_r/
Warning message:
In value[[3L]](cond) :
  Failed to parse /private/var/folders/79/r64__m69265225l_g6lz7r8m0000gp/T/RtmpSI0oBe/file9e7859653ece/00 R - Building Dashboard v4.R ; dependencies in this file will not be discovered.

I think the issue may have something to do with a package called packrat, but have no idea about how to go ahead and fix it. Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Best
Dylan

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Deploying shiny app - failed to parse due to dependencies
parts:
First of all, that is a warning during deployment, it is not preventing the deployment.

If that file is not part of the code that should be executed in the Shiny application, exclude it from the files that are bundled and deployed and the warning will go away.

Launching your application, there is a failure, which you should be able to debug by looking at your application's logs.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#debugging-your-application
